test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"hurricane."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Hurricane"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. • It is a noun that refers to a violent tropical storm with strong winds and heavy rain. (बहुत तेज़ हवाओं वाली उग्र आँधी, आँधी-तूफ़ान) • The word is pronounced as **"hur-uh-kin" or "hur-uh-kuhn."** • The sentence means that the space had the appearance of having been through a powerful storm. • The correct answer is Option 2. • **Correct passage**: The room looked as though a **hurricane**__ had swept through it. The storm had blown ______ (2) ______ the French doors during the night, and the wind and the rain had wreaked havoc, ______ (3) ______ everything before it. A few ______ (4) ______ pages of the report lay on the wet rug, but the rest of the pages had obviously been carried ______ (5) ______ by the wind. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • **"Spring"** is a season of the year characterized by warmer weather and the blooming of flowers. (ग्रीष्म ऋतु तथा शरद ऋतु के मध्य का वह समय जब मौसम थोड़ा गरम होने लगता है तथा पेड़, पौधो में नई पत्तियाँ आ जाती हैं; वसंत ऋतु) • **Example**: *I love to go for walks in the park during **spring**__.* • **"Dream"** is a noun that refers to a series of thoughts, images, and sensations occurring in a person's mind during sleep. (सपना, स्‍वप्‍न) __ • **Example**: *I had a **dream**__ that I was flying last night.* • **"Broom" **is a household cleaning tool used for sweeping floors. (लंबे डंडे वाला झाड़ू, बुहारी, कूँचा) __ • **Example**: *Please use the **broom**__ to clean the kitchen.* 197:Tbb8, The correct answer is **"open."**
